summary: InflaRx N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting an underwritten public offering of 75,000,000 ordinary shares at $2.00 per share, for gross proceeds of ~$150 million. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration statement and closed on May 7, 2026. The filing describes the underwriting agreement with Guggenheim Securities and includes legal opinions. As a routine capital raise via a shelf takedown, this does not constitute a special situation such as a restructuring, rights offering, or going-private transaction. There are no terms indicating activist, M&A, or unusual structural features. The event is an ordinary equity issuance by a life sciences company.
